item.description: This 1999 Cadillac DeVille is powered by a 4.6-liter Northstar V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transaxle, and it is finished in Light Bronzemist Metallic over Light Beige leather. Equipment includes a beige vinyl roof, electronic rear level control, and 16" wheels in addition to heated power-adjustable front seats, cruise control, automatic climate control, and an Alpine head unit with Bluetooth connectivity. item.description: This 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 Cup is powered by a naturally-aspirated 4.0-liter flat-six linked to a six-speed sequential transaxle and a limited-slip differential. Power is routed through a three-speed automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential, and the car is equipped with 15" Enkei EK24 wheels, power steering, long-tube headers, an Offenhauser intake manifold, and drum brakes.
